disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; DSM-IV criteria. Discovery dataset (UCLA-LA5c): n=37 after exclusions (original n=50). Validation dataset 1 (COBRE): n=61 after exclusions (original n=72). Combined clinical cohort total: n=98.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The CNP dataset... includes multimodal imaging from 142 patients with psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia (n = 50)... The COBRE group comprised 72 patients with schizophrenia"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Discovery dataset: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP/OpenfMRI), n=37 SCZ after exclusions. Validation dataset 1: Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), n=61 SCZ after exclusions.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset was obtained from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP)... The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)"

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed across two datasets. UCLA-LA5c SCZ: n=37, mean=35.54, SD=9.08. COBRE SCZ: n=61, mean=36.57, SD=12.97. Weighted mean = (37×35.54 + 61×36.57) / 98 = 36.18. Pooled SD = sqrt((36×9.08² + 60×12.97²) / 96) = sqrt(13061.32/96) = 11.67.

sex.detail: Combined across UCLA-LA5c (n=37, male%=57.50% → est. 21 males, 16 females; 37×0.575=21.275, rounded) and COBRE (n=61, male%=78.69% → 48 males, 13 females; 48/61=78.69% exact). Combined: male_n=69, female_n=29, total n=98, male%=70.4% (69/98). Note: male% 57.50% with n=37 does not yield an exact integer; male_n estimated by rounding.

disorder-name.detail: Bipolar disorder; DSM-IV criteria. Discovery dataset (UCLA-LA5c) only: n=40 after exclusions (original n=49). Confirmed by subtype composition: subtype 1 BD=25 + subtype 2 BD=15 = 40.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "bipolar disorder (BD, n = 49)... subtype 1 encompassed 70 patients (schizophrenia, n = 14; BD, n = 35; ADHD, n = 31), while subtype 2 included 44 patients (schizophrenia, n = 23; BD, n = 15; ADHD, n = 6)"
disorder-name.location: Fang2024.pdf.md: Methods / Datasets, L80; Results, L130

age.detail: Discovery dataset (UCLA-LA5c), BD group (n=40). Age mean and SD as reported in Table S1.

sex.detail: Discovery dataset (UCLA-LA5c), BD group (n=40). Male% reported as 54.05% (rounded to 54.1% for answer). Estimated male_n = round(40×0.5405) = 22; female_n = 18. Note: 22/40=55.0% does not match reported 54.05%; exact fraction 20/37=54.054% suggests possible denominator inconsistency in the original table, but n=40 is confirmed by subtype composition. Reported percentage used as-is.

disorder-name.detail: Depression; diagnosed using Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV by two independent psychiatrists. Symptom severity assessed with Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression (HAMD). Validation dataset 2 (DIRECT site 20): n=282.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "282 patients diagnosed with depression... Two psychiatrists independently assessed diagnoses using the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV. Patients had no comorbidities with other psychiatric disorders, and symptom severity was assessed using the Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression (HAMD)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Validation dataset 2: site 20 of the Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT). Single-site dataset (largest site selected to prevent multi-site effects). Patients recruited from the First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical School, China.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The validation dataset 2 was obtained from site 20 of the Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT)... The single-site dataset with the largest sample size (site 20) was used to prevent multi-site effects"

age.detail: Validation dataset 2 (DIRECT site 20), Depression group (n=282). Age mean and SD as reported in Table S1.

sex.detail: Validation dataset 2 (DIRECT site 20), Depression group (n=282). Male% reported as 35.11% (rounded to 35.1% for answer). male_n = round(282×0.3511) = 99 (99/282=35.11% ≈ exact); female_n = 183.
